acceptanceCriteria.text: The PR #17 benchmark (fix/idle-stop-running-shell vs its base 2971419) grades A with 100/100 flake runs and the same gate meanings, in about 2–2.5 min on this machine
fireguard's own tests pass (except the symlink test that needs Developer Mode locally)
lint, typecheck, deadcode and build pass

body:
`npm run fireguard` took 14 min on a quiet machine (40+ min reported under load) for PR #17 (11 graded tests, 11 changed modules). Flake (100 sequential `vitest run`s at ~7 s) was most of it; mutation added ~2 min (8 working-tree copies, 181 whole-module mutants, a fresh vitest per mutant).

Change (in `fireguard/`):
- Lanes: each lane is a temporary snapshot of HEAD (`git read-tree` + `checkout-index` through a temporary index, `node_modules` linked) with one long-lived vitest (`src/vitestLane.mjs`) that runs each test run over IPC. Runs still get fresh workers, so they stay isolated.
- Flake runs spread over the lanes, each lane capped to its CPU share (total ≈ one `vitest run`).
- Mutants only on lines the diff changed, sharing the lanes with flake runs; reported only if flake passes.
- Grades the committed tree: AST reads `HEAD:path`, tests run in snapshots, so uncommitted edits never leak into a run.

Thresholds unchanged (100 runs, 0% flake, ≥75% mutation).
title: Make fireguard grade a PR-sized change in about 2 minutes
